title: Fixed-design power for interrupted time series and stepped-wedge trials
summary: Attainable power for a prespecified interrupted-time-series grid by seeded simulation, and for a cross-sectional stepped-wedge design by the Hussey-Hughes nested-exchangeable GLS variance.
pinned_defaults: Interrupted time series: seeded negative-binomial data generation and the prespecified quasi-Poisson segmented model; report attempted replicates, successful fits, failures and Monte Carlo standard error.
Interrupted time series: power is conditional on the fixed time grid and is an upper bound when residual serial autocorrelation is omitted.
Stepped wedge: cross-sectional sampling, equal cluster-period sizes, fixed period effects and a nested-exchangeable correlation; CAC defaults to one.
Stepped wedge: normal-reference power can be optimistic with few clusters; the output is attainable power at fixed clusters and periods, not an individual-level sample-size calculation.
